power.artifact_power.amount: Number of debuff applications that may be prevented, not debuff magnitude or turns.

power.strength_power.amount: Signed additive attack-damage modifier; negative Strength is distinct from the delayed Flex/Shackled powers.
notes: Application sign/type and changes of an existing signed amount are not the same as a separate Strength Down identity. Do not universally apply Strength to HP loss, orb damage or triggered THORNS damage.

power.dexterity_power.amount: Signed modifier to calculated card Block, not every source of Block.
notes: Raw power, relic and Frost Block do not automatically receive the card Block calculation. Dexterity Down/DexLoss is a separate delayed-loss power.

power.focus_power.amount: Signed modifier to Lightning/Frost values and future Dark growth; Plasma is unaffected.
notes: Changing Focus does not retroactively change a Dark Orb's already accumulated damage.

Initial-application timing, source-monster flags, player/enemy clocks and reapplication require their qualified lifecycle; 'duration' alone does not define when to decrement.

power.vulnerable_power.amount: Remaining duration, not the damage multiplier.

power.frail_power.amount: Remaining duration, not the percentage Block penalty.
notes: Ordinary calculated card Block is reduced by 25%; raw power/relic/orb Block is not automatically modified. Turnip and Artifact have application-prevention roles.

power.poison_power.amount: Captured HP-loss payload for the next tick; the current stack is reduced by one after delivery.
power.poison_power.turn_progression: Queue captured-amount HP loss at the afflicted creature's start-turn; the loss action then reduces the currently present Poison by one.
power.poison_power.removal: Reduction removes the current Poison at zero. Prevention, replacement, dead/battle-ending guards and terminal interruption remain distinct.
notes: Poison is HP_LOSS, not an Attack and not Block-reduced. Its afflicted-owner clock is different from Noxious Fumes' player post-draw application clock.
Catalyst requests another application based on action-time Poison; it is not an unconditional direct multiplication of a field.

power.noxious_fumes_power.turn_progression: At player post-draw start-turn, request the stacked amount of Poison separately on eligible enemies.
notes: Not the same event as the enemy's own Poison tick. The draft includes a monsters-basically-dead guard.

power.gain_strength_power.amount: Signed Strength restoration amount, stored separately from the preceding Strength loss.
power.gain_strength_power.removal: At the affected creature's end-turn request Strength restoration and self-removal; cleansing/prevention can break loss/restoration symmetry.
notes: Shackled is technically a DEBUFF despite restoring Strength. Piercing Wail/Dark Shackles have source-specific Artifact-presence capture rules; do not rebuild eligibility after earlier queued applications.

power.lose_strength_power.amount: Strength to lose later, not the creature's current signed Strength.

notes: Flex's immediate Strength gain and the delayed expiry debuff are separate applications. Preventing/cleansing the latter need not undo the former.

power.lose_dexterity_power.amount: Dexterity to lose at the delayed end-turn checkpoint; not current negative Dexterity.
notes: Keep the temporary gain and its expiry application separate. The exact mixed-relic/copy/end-turn arbitration is not certified by the tooltip.

power.watcher_end_turn_death_power.amount: Nonstacking marker, documented amount -1; not a duration or unconditional defeat instruction.

discrepancies: The wiki table labels Blasphemer Debuff. The existing Watcher draft explicitly reports EndTurnDeath inherits BUFF; practical harm and technical classification differ.

discrepancies: The wiki table labels Block Return Buff. The Watcher draft explicitly identifies the enemy-carried power as a stacking DEBUFF.

power.choke_power.effect: When the player uses a card, request the stacked amount of HP loss from the afflicted enemy carrying Choked.

discrepancies: The wiki table labels Choked Buff; the Silent draft identifies Choked as a separate DEBUFF application.

power.watcher_energy_down_power.amount: Energy-loss intensity, separate from Fasting's Strength and Dexterity grants.
